headline: US Special Forces Soldier Charged for Making $400K on Classified Venezuela Betting
summary: A US Army Special Forces soldier has been charged with using classified information to make over $400,000 betting on Polymarket prediction markets. Gannon Ken Van Dyke, 38, allegedly used confidential details about a January operation to capture former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro to place 13 successful wagers.
key_points: Van Dyke made approximately $400,000 through betting on classified military operations
The soldier was involved in the January operation that captured Nicolas Maduro
Charges include wire fraud, commodities fraud, and theft of government information
Van Dyke placed around 13 wagers on Polymarket using insider knowledge of US forces entering Caracas
